sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C,Pawan Kumar Mishra
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Donadi Ramesh,J.
1.

The case of the petitioners is that the respondents have taken possession of land in excess of what was formally acquired under the provisions of National Highways Act, 1956, while constructing the road.
The petitioners have placed reliance on a report of Lekhpal.

The prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to the respondents to decide their representation for payment of compensation in respect of excess land of which possession had been taken without acquisition.

2. Sri Pawan Kumar Mishra, learned counsel appearing on behalf of respondent no. 1 and Sri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel appearing for the State-respondents submits that the claim of the petitioners has to be decided by the District Level Committee envisaged under Government Order dated 12.05.2016.

sentences.text: Counsel for the petitioners states that the petitioners will approach the said Committee.

4. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioners to approach the said Committee by means of fresh representation alongwith true attested copy of the instant order and in which event, the same shall be decided by the Committee by a speaking order within next twelve weeks.
(Donadi Ramesh, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 19.9.2023
